text:
claire: tiny a11y regression noticed in the Filters flyout accordion. when you open an accordion panel with a mouse, VoiceOver rotor doesn't announce that the section expanded.
diego: can repro. VO just lands on the header and says 'button' but doesn't announce expanded content. aria-expanded seems to toggle visually but maybe not in DOM order.
mina: looked at the DOM: header is <button aria-expanded=\"true\">Label</button> but the content region is position: absolute; moved in DOM after animation.
claire: moving the region in DOM for animation is probably breaking the implicit relationship between the button and the region. screen readers rely on the content being next in the DOM or referenced via aria-controls.
tom: minimal fix: add aria-controls on the button pointing to the panel id and ensure panel has role=\"region\" aria-hidden updated. also make sure we call focus() on the first control inside when it opens via keyboard.
mina: agree. also note keyboard users expect ArrowDown/ArrowUp to move between headers and Space/Enter to toggle. currently Enter toggles but Space sometimes triggers scroll because preventDefault not used.
aria-bot: auto-a11y-scan(flyout-accordion-2734506789): failures: 3 (missing aria-controls, focus restore after close, inconsistent keyboard handler). report: https://ci.internal/a11y/2734506789
claire: proposed checklist:
- add aria-controls on accordion toggle buttons
- panel -> <div id=\"filters-panel-1\" role=\"region\" aria-hidden=\"false\">...
- ensure panel is placed in DOM (not just visually moved)
- keyboard: Space/Enter toggle with e.preventDefault(); Arrow keys move between toggles
- on open via keyboard, focus first interactive control in the panel
- on close, restore focus to the toggle
mina: CSS tweak: focus-visible for headers should be thicker on dark theme: outline: 3px solid #0B3B82; outline-offset: 2px. current 1px is invisible at high zoom.
diego: also saw low contrast in the panel footer action: text #0F2E50 on #E9F5FF ~3.7:1. bump to #052A4D for >=4.5:1.
claire: acceptance criteria for INS-13555:
- Screen readers announce expanded/collapsed state and content via aria-controls and role=region
- Keyboard users can navigate headers with arrow keys; Space/Enter toggles without scroll
- Focus is set to first control on open and restored on close
- Focus outlines meet visibility at 2x zoom
- Footer action contrast >= 4.5:1
aria-bot: created INS-13555, linked scan and checklist, assignee @mina, ETA 4d.\nmina: I'll push a small patch with aria-controls + role=region + keyboard handlers. will include a short VoiceOver clip showing correct announcement.
tom: small note: when moving panel in DOM for animation we can use CSS transform instead of reparenting to keep accessibility tree stable.
claire: good call. prefer transform over DOM moves where possible.
diego: ping me for NVDA repro steps, I'll run a small matrix (NVDA+Firefox, VO+Safari).
mina: thanks all. closing this thread, will update ticket with PR link once ready. :white_check_mark:
